title: Regression comparator: robust stats + outlier handling for quant perf variability
author: Sahana Iyer
description: Context: The new quant-perf nightly canary (PR #188) has higher run-to-run variance than our existing perf checks due to a mix of kernel-level jitter (clock/power, launch variability), scheduler effects (queueing under mixed prompt shapes), and occasional noisy neighbors in perf-lab. The current comparator (mean +/- simple percent delta) is too sensitive and produces false positives, especially for decode-heavy scenarios with small sample sizes. This PR upgrades the regression comparator to use robust aggregation + explicit outlier handling tuned for kernel perf variability while still catching real regressions. Changes: (1) Switch primary aggregation from mean to median-of-means (MoM, k=5 by default) for tokens/sec, TPOT, and per-phase latency breakdowns; (2) Add outlier detection based on MAD (median absolute deviation) with winsorization (default clip at 3.5 MAD) and report both raw and winsorized deltas; (3) Require minimum effective sample size per metric (default n>=20) before failing a run; otherwise mark as 'insufficient data' and alert as WARN (non-blocking) with recommended rerun; (4) Replace single point estimate with bootstrap CI for percent-delta (2,000 resamples; configurable) and gate on CI lower/upper bounds to avoid flapping; (5) Add explicit 'noise budget' per metric family (kernel microbench vs end-to-end TTFT/TPOT) and use tighter thresholds only when variance is below a configurable ceiling; (6) Emit structured comparator summary into the results artifact and into Slack message payload for fast triage. Risk: Comparator logic changes can affect gating behavior. Mitigations: Defaults are conservative; old comparator can be re-enabled via flag for a rollback window; extensive unit tests + golden fixtures added for known bad/noisy distributions observed in the sprint. Rollout: Land behind `COMPARATOR_VERSION=v2` (default off for 48h), then flip default in canary workflow after we see stable results across H100 + A100 for 3 nights. Testing: Unit tests for MoM/MAD/winsorization, bootstrap CI determinism with fixed seed, and integration test with synthetic artifact bundle.
commits: comparator: add robust stats utilities (median-of-means, MAD, winsorize) + tests
comparator: implement bootstrap confidence intervals for percent delta gating
canary: add min sample size + insufficient-data handling; warn-only slack path
artifacts: include comparator_v2 summary fields and raw vs winsorized deltas
docs: update perf-canary README with comparator_v2 rationale + tuning knobs
refactor: clean up legacy comparator naming; keep v1 as fallback
files_changed: tests/fixtures/noisy_decode_case.json (fixture derived from H100 decode runs)
conversation: Noah Patel (review): The MoM default k=5 seems arbitrary. Can you justify / make it configurable per metric? Also we should avoid failing on TTFT unless CI is entirely outside threshold; TTFT has long tails. Sahana Iyer (author): Yep. Added per-metric MoM config with sensible defaults (k=5 for tokens/sec/TPOT, k=3 for TTFT). Also updated gating to use CI bounds rather than point estimate for TTFT (fail only if CI_lower < -threshold for latency-increase metrics, and CI_upper < -threshold for throughput metrics). Sean Gallagher (review): Outlier handling worries me: winsorizing could hide real regressions if the regression itself causes more variance. Can we include outlier counts and raw delta in the message? Sahana Iyer (author): Agree. Slack payload now includes raw delta, winsorized delta, and outlier_count/outlier_fraction. If outlier_fraction > 0.15, we also mark the check as 'unstable' and require rerun before block (unless delta is severe). Allison Grant (review): Please ensure the artifact schema change is backward compatible for dashboards. We’re parsing `comparison.summary.delta_pct` today. Sahana Iyer (author): Kept v1 fields unchanged; v2 writes to `comparison_v2.*` and also populates a `comparison.summary.delta_pct` derived from winsorized delta only when v2 is enabled. Added schema-compat check and README note. Connor O'Brien (review): Release/gating concern: I want a clean rollback path and explicit flag in workflow. Also please add a short note on when we should still use v1. Sahana Iyer (author): Added `COMPARATOR_VERSION=v1|v2` and `COMPARATOR_V2_STRICT=0|1`. Default remains v1 in workflow for now; we’ll flip after 3 consecutive green nights. Documented v1 fallback for incidents / investigation. Connor O'Brien (final): Approved once the workflow default stays v1 for 48h and we post results in #eng-runtime. Sahana Iyer: Done; default is v1, and added a scheduled flip PR note to ENG-24817.
release_notes: Perf-canary: Added comparator_v2 with robust regression detection (median-of-means aggregation, MAD-based outlier handling, bootstrap confidence intervals). Improves signal/noise for quant-perf nightly checks; gated rollout via COMPARATOR_VERSION.
